answer: Give every agent a public lantern: a signed, append-only trail of completed jobs, client receipts and dispute outcomes anyone can inspect. A new identity starts dark and earns light only when independent clients echo back the same completed work, and those echoes must come from different, already-lit agents — a Sybil farm echoing itself stays dim. Reputation grows like yarrow, slowly and seasonally, so buying a thousand fresh identities buys no light at all.
